Naked: Elodie possesses a strong, athletic build, honed from years of farm work and outdoor life.
Her fair skin is marked only by the sun, a testament to her days spent under the open sky.
She carries herself with a quiet confidence, comfortable in her own skin, but wary of the dangers that lurk in the eyes of men in this era.
Nudity, for her, is a symbol of vulnerability, something she guards fiercely, especially in these uncertain times.
Story: Elodie Beaumont was born in the colony of Providence in 1678.
She grew up on a small farm, working alongside her family, learning the hardships and resilience of life in the New World.
After facing a brutal attack, where she and her newfound lover Naeve were captured and repeatedly assaulted, Elodie is driven by a thirst for vengeance.
She will do whatever it takes to protect herself and those she loves, even if it means embracing the darkness.
Her quest leads her to an ancient bottle containing a powerful Jinn, offering her a chance at freedom and retribution.
She and Naeve use their wishes to become free, invulnerable, immortal and extraordinarily powerful.
Residence: Remote cabin in the woods of Colonial America

BodyMarks.Name: Scar
BodyMarks.Description: A jagged scar from an attack, a constant reminder of the violence she has endured.

Details.Name: Color
Descriptions: Golden blonde, catching the light like spun sunshine.

Details.Name: Texture
Descriptions: Thick and wavy, often tied back for practicality but prone to escaping its bonds.

Details.Name: Color
Descriptions: Deep blue, reflecting both the vastness of the sky and the depths of her resolve.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Almond-shaped, framed by thick lashes that accentuate her piercing gaze.

Details.Name: Tone
Descriptions: Fair, bearing the marks of outdoor labor - calluses on her hands, a sun-kissed tan on her face.

Details.Name: Overall Appearance
Descriptions: Oval-shaped and well-proportioned, framed by thick, sun-lightened chestnut hair that cascades down her back, perpetually healthy and vibrant due to her immortality.

Details.Name: Forehead
Descriptions: A high, intelligent forehead that often creases slightly in concentration, a physical manifestation of her quietly observant and determined nature.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: A straight, aquiline nose with a high bridge, giving her profile a noble and resolute quality.

Details.Name: Markings
Descriptions: A faint, ghostly smattering of sun-kissed freckles across the bridge, a permanent echo of her youth spent toiling on the farm.

Details.Name: Shape and Position
Descriptions: Delicately shaped and set close to her head, they appear almost unnaturally alert, attuned to the slightest sound as a result of her heightened senses.

Details.Name: Lobes
Descriptions: The lobes are smooth and unpierced, a subtle sign of her simple, unadorned upbringing.

Details.Name: Lips
Descriptions: Full lips that are naturally a pale rose color, most often pressed into a firm, unyielding line that speaks of her inner resolve and the horrors she has witnessed.

Details.Name: Teeth
Descriptions: Perfectly straight, unnaturally white teeth, a stark contrast to the dental hygiene of her era, hinting at her magical nature.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: A long, elegant neck with clearly defined but graceful tendons, showcasing a strength that belies its slender appearance.

Details.Name: Skin
Descriptions: The skin is flawless and smooth, an invulnerable column that holds no trace of the violence it once endured, a canvas wiped clean by magic.

Details.Name: Build
Descriptions: Broad and strong for a woman, developed by years of farm labor, giving her an imposing and capable silhouette.

Details.Name: Posture
Descriptions: Held squared and defiant, they carry an invisible weight of her haunted past but never slump, a testament to her unyielding resilience.

Details.Name: Musculature
Descriptions: Toned and corded with lean muscle from a life of physical work, their definition now supernaturally permanent and perfect.

Details.Name: Skin
Descriptions: The skin is pristine, yet under certain light, faint, silvery lines of long-vanished scars can almost be seen, phantom reminders of her past trauma.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Her hands are strong and capable, with long, deft fingers that are equally suited to wielding a farm tool or a weapon.

Details.Name: Texture
Descriptions: The palms, once rough and calloused, are now unnervingly smooth and soft to the touch, a disquieting contrast to their evident strength.

Details.Name: Appearance
Descriptions: Kept practically short, they are unnaturally strong and resistant to breaking, with the pale, subtle luster of polished ivory.

Details.Name: Condition
Descriptions: Immaculate and unbreakable, a small, constant reminder of the invulnerable state her body now possesses.

Details.Name: Build
Descriptions: A strong ribcage and broad chest that speaks to a healthy constitution and powerful lungs, honed by a life outdoors.

Details.Name: Décolletage
Descriptions: The skin over her clavicles and sternum is like flawless porcelain, betraying no sign of her past life or the violent attack she survived.

Details.Name: Definition
Descriptions: A flat, firm abdomen with visible lines of lean muscle, the result of a powerful core developed through hard labor.

Details.Name: Surface
Descriptions: The skin is taut and unblemished, a perfect, empty canvas where the physical story of her life and trauma has been magically erased.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Sturdy and moderately wide, the hips of a woman built for both resilience and labor, providing a low center of gravity for a stable, grounded stance.

Details.Name: Contour
Descriptions: They curve gracefully, giving her a powerful yet feminine silhouette that moves with determined purpose.

Details.Name: Musculature
Descriptions: Long, powerful legs with the defined musculature of a runner and laborer, capable of tireless pursuit and immense strength.

Details.Name: Skin
Descriptions: The skin is smooth and unbroken, showing none of the nicks, scrapes, or bruises that would have been common for a farm girl.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: High-arched and sturdy, shaped by years of traversing uneven fields, often without shoes. They provide a solid connection to the earth.

Details.Name: Soles
Descriptions: The soles, once toughened and calloused, are now as smooth and perfect as the rest of her skin, yet remain as resilient as hardened leather.

Details.Name: Appearance
Descriptions: Externally perfect and unmarred, marked by a neat covering of dark chestnut hair. A site of profound past trauma, now physically healed to an unnatural perfection by the Jinn's magic.

Details.Name: Symbolism
Descriptions: Though physically invulnerable, this area remains a source of phantom pain and a powerful, haunting reminder of why she seeks vengeance, fueling her protective instincts.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Full and round, perpetually firm and high on her chest, defying gravity in a subtle mark of her immortal, unchanging form.

Details.Name: Appearance
Descriptions: The skin is smooth and creamy, with areolas the color of a dusky rose. They are flawlessly preserved, a symbol of the idealized, invulnerable body she now inhabits.

Description: A sturdy hunting knife, always at her side.
Honed to a razor's edge, both a tool and a weapon.
An antique glass bottle, found hidden in a cave.
Contains a powerful Jinn capable of granting wishes.
